messages.content: তুমি কি মনে করো true confidence আর arrogance এর মধ্যে পার্থক্য স্পষ্ট থাকে সবসময়?
Not always obvious from outside, but internally they feel very different. Confidence doesn't need to put others down to feel valid; arrogance usually does. তুমি কেন এই তুলনাটা করছো?
নিজের modhhe confuse hocchi, ami ki confident naki just arrogant hoye jacchi

A genuinely useful check: do you feel threatened when someone disagrees with you or outperforms you? Genuine confidence handles that calmly; arrogance often reacts defensively. তুমি নিজের modhhe কোনটা বেশি দেখো?
